newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate dips to 5.73 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate dips to 5.73 percent.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills dropped to 5.73 percent from 5.76 percent last week, a spokeswoman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price increased to 98.573 from 98.565 last week while the minimum price accepted was 98.552.
Banks submitted bids for 17.8 million dinars worth of bills, up from 16.76 million dinars a week ago.
The bills, maturing on October 29, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday. -- Bahrain newsroom +973-524424
